stories.title: A deadly incident and major fire break out at the CFB Wainwright military base in Alberta
stories.reason: Defence Minister David McGuinty confirmed deaths and injuries at one of Canada's busiest live-fire training bases as high winds spread a fire across the fence line, prompting Prime Minister Carney to call the incident 'serious' while the RCMP investigates its cause.

stories.title: CENTCOM says its naval blockade has blocked Iran from exporting at least $25 billion in crude oil
stories.reason: Commander Adm. Brad Cooper said Iran now has no maritime exports or imports besides approved humanitarian aid, and that the US has also frozen $350 million in Iranian cryptocurrency as part of a widening financial pressure campaign tied to the broader war.

stories.title: Czech PM Babis's ANO party is shut out entirely in Senate runoff elections, calling the result 'catastrophic'
stories.reason: None of ANO's 13 runoff candidates won a seat in one of the governing coalition's first major electoral tests, with the pro-European Mayors and Independents party sweeping 10 of 14 contested seats, though analysts say the loss won't destabilize Babis's government given the Senate's limited power.

stories.title: AI-generated political ads top $137 million in the 2026 midterms, with 70% carrying no AI disclosure
stories.reason: Republican-affiliated sponsors account for 81% of the roughly 220 identified ads, up from under $50,000 in AI ad spending in 2024, including a synthetic Bruce Blakeman campaign video fabricating NYC Mayor Mamdani and Governor Hochul without any disclaimer.

stories.title: Italian police clash with protesters in Milan and Bologna as tens of thousands march in Lisbon over living costs
stories.reason: Police used tear gas in Milan and water cannon in Bologna after demonstrations turned violent, part of a wave of cost-of-living protests now hitting Belgium, Italy, Portugal and France as PM Meloni condemned the unrest ahead of next year's election.

stories.title: UN Secretary-General frontrunner Grynspan survives a sixth Security Council straw poll but still faces veto threats
stories.reason: The former Costa Rican vice president was the only candidate to reach the nine 'encourage' votes needed, but two of the five permanent Security Council members who voted against her retain veto power, leaving the race undecided ahead of her Monday meeting with Costa Rica's president.

stories.title: Anthropic signs a 20-year lease for its first Canadian data center, a $10 billion-plus Nova Scotia project
stories.reason: EverWind Fuels will build and own the Point Tupper campus, targeting 95 megawatts by late 2027 and 420 megawatts by 2028, in what the developer calls the largest private investment in Nova Scotia's history, creating roughly 2,000 construction jobs and 215 permanent positions.

stories.title: Pakistani forces and Afghan Taliban fighters exchange fire after militants try to infiltrate from Afghanistan
stories.reason: Hours of fighting in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's Kurram district came as Pakistan accuses Afghanistan's Taliban government of sheltering Pakistani Taliban insurgents, an allegation Kabul denies, amid a UN count of over 1,100 civilian casualties from cross-border violence this year.
